name: Claim that the photon rocket is a floor: no propulsion does better per unit energy

source.located: No external source is cited by the owner (arrival.py:11-13 states the claim uncited; kind 'extrapolation'). The claim's standard lineage: J. Ackeret, 'Zur Theorie der Raketen', Helv. Phys. Acta 19 (1946) 103 (photon rocket) -- pre-arXiv. READ restatement: An T. Le, arXiv:2606.22531v4, Sec. 2, Lemma 2.1 'Mass cost of a momentum path' (cached alphaXiv page text scratchpad/d67/src/casmag/all/2606.22531v4.txt lines 315-331) and the remark at line 506: 'For an initially resting rocket, fixed-frame radiated energy is m_i - m_f cosh d; it differs from the invariant mass depletion m_i - m_f.'
source.via: alphaXiv discover_papers, answer_pdf_queries (title 'Relativistic rocket: Dream and reality'; and 1902.03869 Fuzfa) all returned 'alphaXiv assistant quota exceeded' in this stage. What is READ is Le 2606.22531v4 as alphaXiv page text harvested earlier in this workflow and cached on disk (same text used by the sibling audit relativistic-rocket-photon-exhaust.json). Ackeret 1946, Henriques-Natario arXiv:1105.5235 and Fuzfa arXiv:1902.03869 are NAMED-NOT-READ. The optimality statement itself is re-proved here from 4-momentum conservation (z3), independent of any read source.

published_statement: READ (Le 2606.22531v4 Lemma 2.1, verbatim, cached lines 318-331): 'Let P(s) be a C1 future timelike momentum on a finite interval in one Minkowski vector space, with F = -dP/ds future causal or zero. ... log(M_i/M_f) - d = (L - d) + Int (1 - eta) dw >= 0. In particular, M_f/M_i <= e^{-L} <= e^{-d}. Equality in the first bound requires null nonzero flux almost everywhere ...; equality in the second requires a geodesic velocity path traversed without reversal.' For a straight burn d = artanh(beta), e^d = sqrt((1+beta)/(1-beta)): the photon rocket is the equality case, and the floor is on the REST-MASS (invariant mass) ratio. Line 506 (READ): fixed-frame radiated energy m_i - m_f cosh d 'differs from the invariant mass depletion m_i - m_f'. The source bounds rest mass, not energy; it names two distinct energies and bounds neither as 'per unit energy'.
published_hypotheses: special relativity, one Minkowski vector space (flat spacetime during the burn)
the vehicle has a C1 future-timelike total 4-momentum (a massive body)
F = -dP/ds future causal or zero: the only change of the vehicle's 4-momentum is its own emission of future-causal momentum -- no absorbed, external or negative-energy momentum
the bounded quantity is the invariant (rest) mass ratio M_i/M_f, i.e. total rest mass lost (energy source + reaction mass alike)
equality (the photon rocket) requires null, single-direction exhaust along a non-reversing straight velocity path; any massive or spread exhaust pays MORE rest mass
hypothesis_drift: CHANGED FIGURE OF MERIT at arrival.py:13 -- 'no propulsion does better per unit ENERGY'. The READ result and the z3 proof here bound rest mass lost per unit rapidity, not energy. Under the natural reading of 'energy' (energy liberated from the source = rest mass converted into exhaust kinetic energy), the claim is inverted: photon exhaust carries the LEAST momentum per unit liberated energy of any exhaust (T/P = gamma_u u/(gamma_u - 1) >= 1, equality only at u = 1; rederive C2), and at every beta in the tree's table a u<1 self-contained rocket liberates less energy (27.8x less at the shell's 0.0476 c, 1.73x less at 0.866 c; C3, cross-checked by stepwise integration C5). The two figures coincide only when every kilogram leaving the ship is counted at mc^2, i.e. when energy is defined as total rest mass lost. The canonical entry itself lists ''per unit energy' as the figure of merit; mass ratio used as the quantity reported' -- the two are not the same figure of merit.

DROPPED at arrival.py:13 -- 'no propulsion': the floor holds only under F = -dP/ds future causal (self-contained reaction propulsion). The same file prices two routes outside that class that beat it (reverse slingshot arrival.py:7-10, rest-mass loss zero; magsail arrival.py:14-15, no reaction mass). The canonical entry's first hypothesis restores this scope; the sentence does not state it.

IMPLICIT at arrival.py:11-13, 119 -- flat spacetime, collimated null exhaust, straight burn: none stated; dropping them does not overstate the floor (each relaxation only raises the rest-mass cost), so this is naming, not a defect.
KEPT at arrival.py:161 -- 'a mass ratio of 3.73 at 100% conversion': the quantity the verdict rests on is the rest-mass ratio, inside the READ class, and correctly called a best case.

SIDE-EFFECT at arrival.py:127-128 -- 'costs 2.73 tonnes of perfect antimatter ... 49 KILOGRAMS': if the scarce commodity is antimatter (energy), the photon rocket is NOT the floor on it: an antimatter-heated inert-propellant rocket at u = 0.0299 c liberates 0.00175 M1 c^2 at 0.0476 c, i.e. ~0.9 kg antimatter per tonne landed (half of the converted rest mass if annihilated in pairs) against the photon rocket's 48.8 kg converted (24.4 kg antimatter), at the price of a rest-mass ratio 4.92 instead of 1.049 (C3). Also recorded: 2.73 t is total converted rest mass; the antimatter share if paired is 1.37 t.

CONSUMER OUTSIDE THE CANONICAL OWNER -- warpdrive.py:838-842 'propulsion_fuel_at: ... The photon-rocket floor is efficiency = 1' models fuel = floor/efficiency, and warpdrive.py:1901 asserts fusion is '> 100' times the photon floor. Under the relativistic rocket equation with an ideal nozzle (1 - 1/gamma_u = eff = 0.002) the factor is 21.2, not 499 (C7). The qualitative 'worse than the photon floor' holds; the > 100 factor holds only under the floor/eff model. Recorded, not graded under this key.

rederivation.outcome: RE-DERIVATION OK, exit 0 (z3 get_version_string 5.1.0, sympy 1.14.0, ~3 s). C1 z3: with M0 = gamma M1 + E, 0 = gamma beta M1 + p, E >= 0, E^2 >= p^2 (total exhaust 4-momentum future causal -- and z3 also proves a sum of future-causal vectors is future causal, the induction step for any staging/history), the negation of M0 >= gamma(1+beta) M1 is UNSAT, and equality with E > |p| is UNSAT: the rest-mass floor is a theorem for isolated self-contained emitters with ANY exhaust history, equality iff null collinear exhaust. C2 sympy: thrust per unit jet power T/P = gamma_u u/(gamma_u - 1) > 1 on (0,1), -> 1 at u = 1, -> 2/u as u -> 0: photons give the LEAST momentum per unit energy. C3: E_lib(u) = (1 - 1/gamma_u)(e^{chi/u} - 1) M1 minimised over u beats the photon rocket's gamma(1+beta) - 1 at all six tree betas (27.84x at 0.0476, 1.73x at 0.866, 1.30x at 0.99) while its rest-mass ratio is larger (4.92, 7.48, 19.9): counterexample to the sentence under the energy-liberated reading, and no counterexample to the rest-mass floor. C4 sympy: any self-contained rocket has E_lib >= (gamma - 1) M1; the photon rocket exceeds that floor by exactly gamma beta M1. C5: independent stepwise 4-momentum integration agrees with C3 closed forms to <= 1.3e-5. C6: tree numbers 1.0487888 exact, 3.7314 vs computed 3.7316716 (7e-5, recorded), '18x' = 18.19 exact, '76x' computes to 55.99 (fuel ratio) or 3.558 (mass-ratio ratio) -- discrepancy recorded, not repaired. C7: warpdrive.py floor/eff model gives 499x where the rocket equation gives 21.2x.

lacked_data: M's hypothesis tested for this result: the conclusion uses no measured datum -- it is 4-momentum conservation plus positivity of exhaust energy, and depends only on beta. Nothing Ackeret (1946) lacked would move the rest-mass floor: later Lorentz-invariance tests confirm the input, and realistic annihilation (pions, neutrinos, uncollimated gammas; NAMED, not read here) can only lower eta below 1 and RAISE the rest-mass cost, strengthening the 'floor' reading. What the tree's sentence lacks is not data but the distinction between figures of merit, which is kinematic and was available to the original authors: per unit rest mass the photon rocket is optimal (theorem, z3); per unit liberated energy it is the WORST exhaust (T/P minimal) and is beaten at every tree beta (computed). Evidence either way: no datum moves; the figure of merit does.
grade_evidence: The quantity the tree reports and rests on STANDS: M0/M1 >= sqrt((1+beta)/(1-beta)) is proved here by z3 for any isolated emitter with future-causal exhaust and any emission history (negation UNSAT), matches the READ Le 2606.22531v4 Lemma 2.1 equality case, and every consumer that uses it as a mass ratio (arrival.py:121-128, 161; shipspec.py:142) is inside that class. The sentence at arrival.py:13 holds on a smaller class than it states, in two ways: (1) 'no propulsion' drops the self-contained hypothesis (the owner's own slingshot and magsail are outside it); (2) 'per unit energy' holds only if energy is defined as total rest mass lost -- under energy liberated from the source, a computed counterexample exists at every beta in the tree's table (u = 0.0299 c liberates 27.8x less energy than the photon rocket at 0.0476 c, rest-mass ratio 4.92 vs 1.049), and photon exhaust has the minimum thrust per unit power of any exhaust. This is graded NARROWED rather than WRONG because the tree's hypotheses (canonical entry: mass ratio as the quantity reported; arrival.py:161 '100% conversion') admit the reading under which it is a theorem, and nothing downstream uses an energy-liberated figure; under the energy-liberated reading alone the sentence would be refuted (shown, C2-C3). Discrepancies recorded, not repaired: '76x' (arrival.py:137) computes to 55.99; 3.7314 (arrival.py:74, shipspec.py:142) vs 3.7317; '2.73 tonnes of perfect antimatter' (arrival.py:127) is total converted mass; warpdrive.py:1901's '> 100' fusion factor is 21.2 under the rocket equation.
what_would_change_the_grade: -> STANDS if arrival.py:13 is read as 'no self-contained rocket does better per unit rest mass expended (mass ratio)', which is what every consumer uses. -> WRONG (for the sentence) if the tree ever uses the floor as an ENERGY floor (e.g. to price antimatter or source energy rather than total rest mass): C3 is then a shown counterexample. -> An isolated emitter beating the rest-mass floor would require negative-energy or external momentum -- outside the hypotheses; a read of Henriques-Natario 1105.5235 (GR) or a completed literature search could add qualifications not seen here.
